snippet.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! TAG FORCE GX – Pre-order Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
snippet.description:
Yu-Gi-Oh! TAG FORCE GX is coming February 16, 2026 on Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch! Pre-order today: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/yu-gi-oh-tag-force-gx-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=A1013-01&utm_id=A1013-01

Fan-favorite RPG card game Yu-Gi-Oh! GX TAG FORCE 3 is reborn as Yu-Gi-Oh! TAG FORCE GX with modern visuals, enhanced Dueling, and nostalgic cards from the Yu-Gi-Oh! GX anime era.
 
Your final year at Duel Academy is officially underway! Strengthen your affinity with your classmates and build memories as you study the art of Tag Dueling and prepare for a Graduation Duel to remember. 

Yu-Gi-Oh! TAG FORCE GX marks the debut of Yu-Gi-Oh! GX TAG FORCE 3 content in North and Latin America. 
 
#NintendoDirect #YuGiOhTAGFORCEGX

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s

Subscribe for more Nintendo fun: https://goo.gl/HYYsot
